# fluss-go v0.1.0-beta.9

This prerelease hardens long-lived client recovery and log scanning for
byte-limited Apache Fluss 0.9.1 fetch responses.

## Highlights

- Keeps the logical `fgo.Client` open when a failed managed Coordinator
  connection is discarded and replaced, so metadata, catalog, schema, and
  child-resource operations continue through the replacement transport.
- Makes explicit `Client.Close` terminal and idempotent across requests,
  routing, table access, writers, scanners, lookups, and snapshot providers.
- Accepts fetch responses that contain complete record batches followed by an
  incomplete trailing batch caused by the configured byte limit.
- Preserves all complete row and Arrow batches and resumes the next fetch at
  the last complete offset instead of reporting a malformed record batch.
- Adds unit and live compatibility coverage for row and Arrow truncation,
  including an Arrow batch larger than the default per-bucket fetch limit.

## Upgrade notes

- No exported API, protocol input, or external dependency changed in this
  release.
- Long-lived applications should upgrade so a replaceable Coordinator
  connection does not incorrectly close the logical client.
- Log-scanning applications should upgrade to avoid rejecting valid
  byte-limited responses whose final record batch is incomplete.
- All four optional adapter modules are published at beta.9 and require the
  beta.9 root module.
- The compatibility target remains Apache Fluss `0.9.1-incubating` at commit
  `6bf969f71af8d6f9cc37383ab89ae46a58b0e227`.
- Use Go 1.25.12 or newer in the 1.25 series, or Go 1.26.5 or newer in the 1.26
  series.

See the [full changelog](../../CHANGELOG.md), the
[architecture guide](../../docs/architecture/v0.1.md), the
[data-operations guide](../../docs/data-operations.md), the
[error-handling guide](../../docs/error-handling.md), and the
[release process](../../docs/releasing.md).

This is a pre-v1 release. Pin the root and adapter module versions and review
the changelog before upgrading.
